CREATE PROC [DW].[SP_AGGREGATE_TOTAL_CUSTOMER_HOLDINGS_FACT] @DateProcessed [date] AS
BEGIN


TRUNCATE TABLE dw.AGGREGATE_TOTAL_CUSTOMER_HOLDINGS_FACT;

with DEPOSITS_FACT AS(
    SELECT * FROM DW.DEPOSITS_FACT WHERE AS_OF_DATE =  CAST(@DateProcessed AS DATE)
)


INSERT INTO dw.AGGREGATE_TOTAL_CUSTOMER_HOLDINGS_FACT (
CustomerSK
,CustomerID
,GlobalCIF
,FCBSCIF
,BankSK
,SourceSystemCode
,as_of_date
,Deposits_Outstanding_Balance
,Deposits_Previous_Monthend_Average_Daily_Balance
,Deposits_Year_To_Date_Average_Daily_Balance
,Total_Relationship_Balance
,MarketSegment
,WorkFlowId
,TaskRunId
,InsertDttm
)
SELECT A.*
,CASE WHEN Deposits_Year_To_Date_Average_Daily_Balance <= 0 THEN 'MM' 
      WHEN Deposits_Year_To_Date_Average_Daily_Balance >= 10000000 THEN 'VIP'
      ELSE MarketSegmentName END AS MarketSegment
,0 AS WorkFlowId
,0 AS TaskRunId
,CAST(SYSDATETIMEOFFSET() AT TIME ZONE 'Singapore Standard Time' AS datetime) AS InsertDttm
FROM (
SELECT
 DCA.CustomerSK AS CustomerSK
,DCA.CustomerID AS CustomerID
,DC.GlobalCIF AS GlobalCIF
,DC.FCBSCIF AS FCBSCIF
,DC.BankSK AS BankSK
,DC.SourceSystemCode AS SourceSystemCode
,Convert(CHAR(8),@DateProcessed,112) AS as_of_date
,SUM(CASE WHEN DCA.ShareIndicator = 'Y' THEN DEP_F.Outstanding_Balance_PHP ELSE 0 END) AS Deposits_Outstanding_Balance
,SUM(CASE WHEN DCA.ShareIndicator = 'Y' THEN DEP_F.Previous_Monthend_Average_Daily_Balance_PHP ELSE 0 END) AS Deposits_Previous_Monthend_Average_Daily_Balance
,SUM(CASE WHEN DCA.ShareIndicator = 'Y' THEN DEP_F.Year_To_Date_Average_Daily_Balance_PHP ELSE 0 END) AS Deposits_Year_To_Date_Average_Daily_Balance
,SUM(CASE WHEN DCA.ShareIndicator = 'Y' THEN DEP_F.Year_To_Date_Average_Daily_Balance_PHP ELSE 0 END) AS Total_Relationship_Balance
FROM DEPOSITS_FACT DEP_F
INNER JOIN DW.DIMCUSTOMERACCOUNT DCA ON DCA.AccountID = DEP_F.FORACID 
INNER JOIN DW.DimAccount DA ON DA.AccountSK = DCA.AccountSK  AND ISNULL(DA.ACCOUNTSTATUS,'1') <> 'Closed'
INNER JOIN DW.DIMCUSTOMER DC ON DC.CUSTOMERSK = DCA.CUSTOMERSK
WHERE isnull(DA.ACCOUNTSTATUS,'1') not in ('Closed')
AND @DateProcessed BETWEEN DC.ValidStartDate AND DC.ValidEndDate
AND @DateProcessed BETWEEN DCA.ValidStartDate AND DCA.ValidEndDate
AND @DateProcessed BETWEEN DA.ValidStartDate AND DA.ValidEndDate
GROUP BY  DCA.CustomerSK 
,DCA.CustomerID 
,DC.GlobalCIF 
,DC.FCBSCIF 
,DC.BankSK 
,DC.SourceSystemCode
,DEP_F.AS_OF_DATE ) A
--INNER JOIN DW.DimMarketSegment DMS ON DMS.LowerLimit <= A.Deposits_Year_To_Date_Average_Daily_Balance AND A.Deposits_Year_To_Date_Average_Daily_Balance < DMS.UpperLimit
INNER JOIN DW.DimMarketSegment DMS ON DMS.LowerLimit <= ISNULL(A.Deposits_Year_To_Date_Average_Daily_Balance,
0
) AND ISNULL(A.Deposits_Year_To_Date_Average_Daily_Balance,
0
) < ISNULL(DMS.UpperLimit,
9999999999999
)
END
GO
